proposal.summary: Adive Framework 2.0.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the user add page (userUsername parameter). An attacker can store a malicious script that, when an authenticated admin visits the admin/user page, issues a forged POST to /admin/config to change the Administrator password (CSRF via stored XSS).
proposal.cwe_quote: The parameter 'userUsername=' is vulnerable to Stored Cross-site scripting

AV.quote: attacker can craft a malicious javascript and attach it to the stored xss, when admin visits the /admin/user page the payload will trigger.

PR.quote: when admin visits the /admin/user page the payload will trigger.

UI.quote: when admin visits the /admin/user page the payload will trigger.

C.quote: As soon as admin will visit the page the payload will be triggered and the admin password will be changed to hacked@123

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerability on a test instance, confirm stored XSS in userUsername and the CSRF action to /admin/config, and then patch by properly escaping or validating user input and adding CSRF tokens and same-site cookie protections for admin actions.
